name: Musashibou Benkei
source:
He is a vassal vowed to devote himself to supporting Yoshitsune, who gets into danger.

Because he has inhuman strength, both his appearance and attitude are rough. But actually, he takes good care of people around him, and is respected and loved by friends. Everyone is attracted to him because of his manliness, but inside him, is some hidden past.

Organization: Rebellion
Interests: Feed Yoshitsune the vegetables he grows
